description: Score how ready a small business is for a cyber insurance application, from 12 yes/partly/no/unsure answers about MFA, EDR, updates, backups, training, payment call-backs, and incident planning. Returns a 0-100 readiness score, a band, and a prioritized list of gaps with fixes. Same scoring as https://wizcomltd.com/tools/cyber-insurance-readiness. Educational only: not insurance or legal advice, and Wizcom is not an insurance agency.

backup.description: Do you have a backup copy that hackers couldn't reach or delete, such as one kept offline or locked in the cloud?

edr.description: Does every computer and server have modern security software that watches for attacks and alerts someone?

email_sec.description: Does your email system screen out scam and phishing emails before they reach people?

eol.description: Is everything still supported by its maker, with no old computers or software that no longer get security fixes?

irp.description: Do you have a written plan for what to do if you're hacked, including who to call?

mfa_admin.description: Do your admin accounts, the ones that can add users or change settings, also need the second step?

mfa_email.description: Does everyone need a second step, like a code or a tap on their phone, to log in to work email?

mfa_remote.description: When anyone logs in to your systems from outside the office, is that second step required? Use "na" if nobody logs in remotely.

patch.description: Do computers, software, and network equipment get security updates automatically or on a regular schedule?

payments.description: Before sending a wire or changing someone's bank details, do you call them at a phone number you already have? Use "na" if not applicable.

restore.description: Have you actually restored files from your backup in the past year to prove it works?

training.description: Does your team get cybersecurity training at least once a year, including practice phishing emails?

name: check_cyber_insurance_readiness
title: Check cyber insurance readiness
